name: Boulder County, CO
findings: Boulder County has 1,829 nonprofit organizations. 852 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 691 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Boulder County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Boulder County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 66 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
